turn.text:
Last night's change was supposed to add 6 security rules and 2 routes, but something's off and traffic is inconsistent. Reconcile the device to the intended design (attached).

Site notes: the firewall is `fw` (ssh fw). The intended design is /etc/nb/CHG-2211.md on fw.
Plan: cat /etc/nb/CHG-2211.md; nft -a list chain inet filter forward; ip route show | grep -E '^10\.6[01]\.'; nft add rule inet filter forward ip saddr 192.168.10.0/24 oifname eth2 tcp dport 443 accept; nft add rule inet filter forward ip saddr 192.168.10.0/24 ip daddr 192.168.30.10 tcp dport 80 accept; nft add rule inet filter forward ip saddr 192.168.10.0/24 ip daddr 10.1.0.0/16 log prefix '"CHG2211-R6 "' drop; ip route add 10.61.0.0/16 via 10.1.0.254

result.output:
# Change CHG-2211 intended design (approved)
Security rules (inet filter forward):
 R1 allow LAN 192.168.10.0/24 -> WAN tcp/80
 R2 allow LAN 192.168.10.0/24 -> WAN tcp/443
 R3 allow LAN 192.168.10.0/24 -> WAN udp/53
 R4 allow LAN 192.168.10.0/24 -> DMZ 192.168.30.10 tcp/80
 R5 allow INT 10.1.0.0/16 -> DMZ 192.168.30.10 tcp/22
 R6 drop  LAN 192.168.10.0/24 -> INT 10.1.0.0/16 (log prefix "CHG2211-R6 ")
Routes:
 T1 10.60.0.0/16 via 10.1.0.254
 T2 10.61.0.0/16 via 10.1.0.254
The generic 'iifname eth1 oifname eth2 accept' rule is replaced by R1-R3.
